[S1] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Kya AI model ko customer review (course-material) [Lesson 07; lesson_7]

Reviewed English translation: Do not present an AI actor as a real reviewing customer. Use an honest product demonstration or UGC-style showcase without claiming genuine customer experience.

[S2] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — UGC video (course-material) [Lesson 07; lesson_7]
• Flow → Video → Ingredients: chehra + character sheet + product sheet. • Course settings: 9:16, 720p, 8 sec. • Prompt: camera hi phone hai, frame mein koi phone nahi; ghar ka kamra, studio nahi. • Dialogue chhota (Hindi, Devanagari mein likho), L05 ke hook se.
Reviewed English translation: In Flow choose Video → Ingredients and attach the face, character sheet and product sheet. Recorded settings: 9:16, 720p, 8 sec. The camera itself is the phone: no phone should appear in the frame. Use a normal home room and short dialogue written in Hindi Devanagari, based on the L05 hook. Do not present an AI actor as a real reviewing customer.

[S3] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Product sheet banana (course-material) [Lesson 02; lesson_2]
• Phone se product ki 5–7 photos, alag angles, din ki roshni, flash off, details saaf. • Google Flow → New project → Image → Nano Banana Pro. • Saari photos upload/reference mein lagao → product sheet prompt chalao. • Sheet achhi na aaye toh dobara generate karo. Achhi sheet ko save rakho — poore course mein yahi reference hai.
Reviewed English translation: Take 5–7 clear phone photos from different angles in daylight, with flash off. In Google Flow choose New project → Image → Nano Banana Pro. Upload all photos as references and run the Product Sheet template. Review, regenerate if needed, and save the best sheet for later shots.

[S4] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Final ad kaise edit karein? (course-material) [Lesson 08; lesson_8]
Final ad kaise edit karein? Course mein CapCut tutorial nahi hai; final ad ka order: UGC hook → product videos → UGC → end card (price + order kaise karein). Text aur price editing mein daalo, AI se nahi.
Reviewed English translation: CapCut editing is not taught as a full tutorial in this course. The basic final-ad order is UGC hook → product videos → UGC → end card with the real price and how to order. Add text and price during editing, not with AI image generation.

• Ek hi chat mein: details + price + kahan bechte ho → 3 buyers, problems, angles. • Angle chuno → 5 hooks + 15-sec script + caption, "use only the features I gave you". • Flow ke 3 image prompts likhwao → Flow mein product sheet ke saath chalao. • Output padh ke jhoothe/unproven claims hatao.
Reviewed English translation: Provide real product details, price and where you sell. First ask for three buyer types, their problems and an ad angle for each. Choose one angle, then request 5 hooks, a 15-second script and an Instagram caption. Use only supplied features; add no unsupported claims. Next request 3 Google Flow image prompts and run them with the product sheet. Review and remove false or unproven claims.

[S6] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — L05 Step 3 Flow prompts (course-material) [Lesson 05; lesson_5]
Now write 3 image prompts for Google Flow (Nano Banana) for this ad. Each prompt must start with: "Use the uploaded product sheet as the reference. Keep the [product] exactly the same — same shape, same colour, same details, same text and logo, do not redesign it." Then describe one scene for the ad.
